answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Reaching the falcon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the umber of a task receipt, and the tide is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
